tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Quantity may Vary based on Fund availability and Requirement
The bids should be unconditional and conditional bids will be summarily rejected.
All terms and conditions as per tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: All technical evaluation criteria as per tender document

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: If the bidder is an authorized dealer, then the dealer should have achieved cumulative sales turnover of not less than Rs. 20.00 lakhs Rupees Twenty Lakhs Only in the past 2 years and proof of the same should be submitted.

If the bidder is manufacturer being sought to be supplied as per this tender process, then the annual turnover of the bidder shall not be less than Rs.50,00,000 Fifty Lakhs Proof of the same should be furnished.
The bidder should be a registered dealer under Goods and services Tax Act of any State and proof of the same should be submitted along with the tender document.

The bidder should be the original equipment manufacturer OEM or an authorized dealer having authorized permission from industries & commerce and labour Department Proof of the same should be submitted along with the tender document.
The bidder should submit a tax clearance certificate issued by the Goods and services tax authority concerned till the end of the preceding financial year or up to date

The successful bidder or his authorized agent should have set up service centre in karnataka for effective and efficient overall maintenance of the Electrical Sewing Machines for carrying out repairs, replacement of parts etc. during the warranty period and thereafter. The particulars of such service centres like address, telephone numbers etc., should be furnished.
Upload all other documents as per tender document
